calls.title: Contextual bandits & AI
calls.summary: The meeting focused on how contextual bandits combined with AI can automate and optimize multi-variant testing for marketing personalization. The integration of a Visual Editor aims to simplify the setup process for marketing teams, allowing for easy variant generation without engineering input. AI will assist by auto-detecting user attributes and summarizing performance metrics to aid configuration. The primary users identified are marketing teams, benefiting from straightforward use cases like promotional campaigns and targeted emails. Dynamic variant management will facilitate ongoing adaptation in live campaigns, while strategies for boosting adoption, such as the Visual Editor and educational resources, were also discussed.
calls.keywords: contextual bandits, AI variant generation, personalization, visual editor, marketing optimization, experimentation
